incomeAssessment.scope: Targeted household payments, benefits and housing resources; original clinical estimate is a partial reference, not complete portfolio value.
incomeAssessment.rationale: Reported respite and housing clients establish activity, and the benefits vignette establishes a resource mechanism. Neither supplies a current unique household/payment cohort or retained dollar amount. Hospital savings are payer outcomes, not disposable client resources.
directions: Additional retained SNAP/general relief or disability benefits may raise consumption; taxes and other benefits withdrawn must be netted.
Housing may replace actual rent or increase rent and food obligations relative to shelter or institutional alternatives.
Medical private payments, travel, time and opportunity costs require actual alternative coverage and discharge arrangements; full burdens are independent of clinical response.
Employment assistance and family supports remain unquantified; no gross wages or retail housing/care value is credited.
